newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Aug 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its business page on Aug. 19:
NEW YORK - Last week's bears took flight as the fickle stock market, shaking off Friday's 247-point decline in Dow Jones industrial average, gained 108.7 points back.
PARIS - Europeans fear that fragmentation in their defense industry may make rivalry with U.S. firms tough.

WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve officials are likely to leave short-term interest rates unchanged at their policymaking session today, although they remain a bit puzzled about why inflation and unemployment remain so low.
